info.name: Jev-style decision models · Local with Ollama
info.description:
Decision models running locally on Ollama (0.35+). No API key, no auth.

Setup: ollama pull tev1:0.8b

POST {{baseUrl}}/v1/systemone with { model, state, questions }. Question types: choice, noul (yes/no), score.

Switch the `model` variable to tev1 or nimble to compare.

Source: https://ollama.com/blog/ollama-now-supports-jev-style-decision-models
